case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar. Need: 94800 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 10 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200008. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some insight into our cost environment: AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your offer and for the transparent view of your cost drivers. We value the cooperation and would like to find a workable solution together.

Our own records show a different picture:

Our orders of Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm, peeled with you were placed at EUR 5.45 on 2024-10-07 (po:4500011523-10), EUR 5.33 on 2025-06-05 (po:4500012560-10), EUR 5.24 on 2026-01-26 (po:4500013482-10) and EUR 5.45 on 2026-09-24 (po:4500014455-10): the price has not risen.

Your on-time delivery was 88.0% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70710@2026Q3).

Where we can meet you is on the other terms. The options below are structured so you can take them straight to your pricing committee. They differ in payment term and index mechanism, and we are happy to provide any further documents your approval requires.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.99; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.92; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08); payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.96; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Furthermore, we have verified your records regarding historical pricing and delivery performance, and have adjusted our calculation accordingly. Building on your Option B, we accept the 24-month contract, 60-day payment terms, and the AS-14404 index clause. 

Under these parameters, we propose a revised price of EUR 5.51 per unit. As a dedicated distributor, we always strive to support your range of needs. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. To give you full transparency and stability, we can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. 

Our current offer includes a price of €5.51 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This valid proposal remains open for 30 days. We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Logistics: We are well loaded. Our Lieferzeit is 10 days, and with overtime we can deliver in 10 days, at a premium.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your constructive reply, for checking our records, and for accepting the index clause on the alloy surcharge. That is a real step forward.

We cannot reach your proposed price, but we have kept the structure you asked for. The three options below are laid out so that they are easy to take to your pricing committee. If the committee needs a different format or further detail, please tell us.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.06; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08); payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.99; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 3 %, base 2026-08); payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.03; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08); payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

We look forward to your response.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your continued constructive approach and for increasing your offer. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Building on your Option C, we are pleased to maintain the 60-day payment terms, the 24-month contract, and the AS-14404 index clause. In response to your movement, we have adjusted our price to EUR 5.39 per unit, representing a further step to help you secure internal approval. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €5.35 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.39 per unit, combined with a price of €5.39 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We appreciate your continued flexibility and the increased offer. Building on your Option C, we have reduced our price to EUR 5.34 per unit while maintaining the 60-day payment terms and 24-month contract. This represents a further step from our side to help you secure internal approval. 

Please note that this is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot stands at a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Alternatively, we can offer a price of €5.34 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.34 per unit.

We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your final offer and for the effort behind it. We value the way this discussion has been handled on both sides, and we are glad to accept your alternative proposal as offered.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 5.34; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08); payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

For your pricing committee, this confirms the terms exactly as you set them out. If your approval process needs a written confirmation or any further detail from us, please let us know and we will provide it.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
